# OHLC Dataset Catalog — v0 (REST-seeded)

> **Retired 2026-07-18 (iter-103, spec `00056` D4):** the on-disk `data/ohlc` set was **deleted**. It is the v0 REST seed, fully superseded by `ohlc-full` (which reconstructs it **bit-identical** from the OHLCVT dumps — [[T0001]]), so it carried no unique data. This catalog is kept as the historical record of the v0 dataset; the storage paths below no longer exist.

**Iteration:** iter-004 · **Phase:** 1 (Data Foundation) · Generated by `cli/ohlc/` (see
`docs/specs/00002-ohlc-ingest-design.md`), seeded from Kraken's **public REST `OHLC`** endpoint (no API
key). REST caps at ~720 candles per interval, so this v0 dataset covers roughly the last ~2 years of
daily bars, ~4 months of 4h bars, and ~30 days of 1h bars — enough to build and validate the ingestion
pipeline, but **not** the full multi-regime history the master plan's §9 walk-forward validation needs.
The full 2019/2020→2026 history lives only in Kraken's downloadable OHLCVT ZIP archive; backfilling it
is parked in **[T0001](open-topics/T0001-ohlcvt-full-history-backfill.md)**, which this pipeline will
later feed.

**Fetched at:** 2026-07-07T04:12:55.776871+00:00 (UTC)

**Pair-key resolution:** `cli.snapshot.derive_universe` against a live `AssetPairs`/`Assets` fetch — all
12 `CANDIDATE_SYMBOLS` (master plan §3) resolved to a Kraken pair key.

**Intervals:** the §6 decision cadence — 1d (1440), 4h (240), 1h (60) — `cli.ohlc.DEFAULT_INTERVALS`.

**Storage:** `data/ohlc/{symbol}/{interval}.parquet` + `data/ohlc/manifest.json` (gitignored — not
committed; this catalog is the reproducible record). Each series is referenced by its `dataset_hash`
(sha256 over the frame's canonical CSV bytes), never "latest" (§8) — a backtest cites the hash below,
not a live path.

All 12 symbols × 3 intervals = 36 series, each exactly 721 rows (Kraken's REST cap) — no gaps or
short series in this fetch.

## Reproducing

```python
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from cli.ohlc import DEFAULT_INTERVALS, ingest_basket
from cli.snapshot import CANDIDATE_SYMBOLS, derive_universe, fetch_public

assetpairs = fetch_public("AssetPairs")
assets = fetch_public("Assets")
universe = derive_universe(assetpairs, assets, list(CANDIDATE_SYMBOLS))
pair_keys = {row.symbol: row.pair_key for row in universe if row.found}

# Writes data/ohlc/{symbol}/{interval}.parquet plus data/ohlc/manifest.json, and returns the same
# manifest dict as written.
manifest = ingest_basket(pair_keys, DEFAULT_INTERVALS, Path("data/ohlc"), datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
```

Re-running this will refetch the current ~720-candle REST window (not the same historical span as
above — Kraken's REST window rolls forward), so a fresh run's `dataset_hash`es will differ from the
table above; that is expected and is exactly why datasets are referenced by hash, not by path.

## Notes

- This is the **v0, REST-seeded** dataset (iter-004). It exists to build and validate `cli/ohlc/`, not
  to serve real backtests — the 4h/1h windows in particular are far too short (~4 months / ~30 days)
  for the master plan's §9 walk-forward regime slices.
- Full-history ingestion from Kraken's downloadable OHLCVT ZIP archive is parked in
  [T0001](open-topics/T0001-ohlcvt-full-history-backfill.md); that backfill will feed this same
  `cli/ohlc` pipeline and this catalog will be regenerated once it lands.
